graph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":84},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":39,"text":"【秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务】"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":46,"text":"把金色十字星拎在手里把玩了半晌，比起那个莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对这枚所谓的“守护之星”倒是更感兴趣，眼中甚至逐渐放出光彩。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":58,"text":"不是，你这秘典都不给点新手指引的吗，别人拿到系统多少都有个新手任务好伐，至少教我怎么变身嘛！"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":84},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":3,"returned":3},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":84},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":17,"text":"与镜中的自己对视了半晌，苏天晴猛然察觉到自己这样的举动很像个变泰，脸颊微红，轻咳两声收敛发癫的状态，开始认真审视起自己身体中残留的记忆。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人就叫苏天晴，这里与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但却是人类与兽人共存的一个世界。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":20,"text":"虽然名义上共存，但兽人数量远远不及人类，苏天晴从小便独自一人孤独地长大，虽然模样可爱但社恐孤僻，好在有兽人互助协会的资助顺利考上蓉城最好的医学院，却又在临近开学时染上一场兽人流感，熬夜过程中突发了暴发性心肌炎……"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":23,"text":"想到这，苏天晴不由得感觉胸口幻痛，连忙伸手去揉了揉。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":25,"text":"简单洗漱了一遍，苏天晴踩着不合脚的大拖鞋走到客厅，一边躺上沙发，一边顺手从茶几上拿起刚才那本跟自己说话的古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":30,"text":"揣着一丝侥幸，苏天晴举起手中这本古书，翻开扉页。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":33,"text":"一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，狠狠砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":46,"text":"把金色十字星拎在手里把玩了半晌，比起那个莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对这枚所谓的“守护之星”倒是更感兴趣，眼中甚至逐渐放出光彩。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":63,"text":"盯着十字星中间那枚刚好能容纳下一只手指的凹陷看了半晌，苏天晴试探着将拇指摁了进去。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":84},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":16,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":true,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJxdWVyeSI6IjZkYzI2YzU2NDg4YzdiMGQ0OTQ2MTBiOThlYTRkNzExMmU4YjNhNGJmOTJkZTc1YWY4NGIzZmExZTFkNDE3YzYiLCJvZmZzZXQiOjEwLCJjaGVja3N1bSI6IjkyZjgwNTc5MDRhNzU5NzRhMzAxNDczMDA3N2Q1YmRjY2M2Y2EwODkxZTBkYjE4ZDZmODAzYzQwOWM4ODIwNzcifQ"}]}]}
